rules.growthDirection: Increase horizontal volume in approved shoulder, chest, back, arm, pelvis, thigh, and calf regions; do not increase character height.
rules.muscleLineProgression: Muscle lines increase gradually with growth stage and definition and remain minimal at Stage 0.
rules.styleIdentity: white body + black hand-drawn outline + simple hands/feet + slightly awkward loose drawing
rules.fixedFaceRule: Use the v3 rounded crown and cheeks, gently tapered jaw, rounded chin, wide dot-eye spacing, and broad upward smile at every stage.
rules.runtimeAssetPolicy: The v3 PNG stages are visual references, not full-body runtime replacements. Runtime growth remains the parametric layered renderer.
rules.notes: The v3 PNG master and the user-approved parametric renderer are LOCKED together. Do not replace runtime growth with full-body PNG switching, player_main.png, graphite/geometric silhouettes, 3D, semi-realistic art, or a cleaner mascot redesign.
